sentences.text:
Manvendra Singh Shekhawat, PP with Ms. Amrita Duhan, SP Kota City Mr. Pankaj Gupta with Mr.
Naman Yadav for respondent No.2 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SAMEER JAIN Order 08/10/2024
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is a bonafide businessman.

It is further submitted that on 22.08.2023, a person named 'Saklen' demanded a ransom of Rs. 5 lacs from the petitioner, aggrieved of which an FIR No. 109/2023 was lodged on 22.08.2023 at Police Station Makbara (Kota) for offence under Sections 384, 386, 504, 506 of IPC by the petitioner.
Consequentially, the petitioner was taken in illegal custody on 29.04.2024, in the disguise of an inquiry.
Further, it is submitted that certain police officials are a threat to the petitioners' safety, security and protection.

Additionally, it is submitted that some of the respondents (including certain police officials) are hand-in-glove with certain gunda/racketeer elements/persons and are giving the petitioner regular threats and coercing him qua certain criminal proceedings.
Moreover, even the representations filed by the petitioner are not considered by the respondents in the requisite manner.
Considering the vital facts of the instant matter, notices were issued.
Thereafter, in pursuance to same factual report was filed.

[2024:RJ-JP:42284] (3 of 3) [CRLW-1158/2024] Additionally, Superintendent of Police, Kota has marked her presence and has submitted that the instant investigation is already assigned to an Officer, equivalent to the rank of Additional Superintendent of Police.

It is further informed that the petitioner no. 2 has circulated her photographs on social media and public at large, along with arms and objectionable items, qua which an investigation is carried out by the Police Officers.

Superintendent of Police has also appraised the Court with the fact that there is a criminal antecedent registered against the petitioner no. 3 for offence under section 420 of IPC at Police Station, Sikar.

Considering disputed questions of facts and submissions of Superintendent of Police, this Court deems it apposite to dispose of the instant petition, with a direction that the representation of the petitioner be considered by the Superintendent of Police, Kota.

The petitioner in person or via advocate is directed to appear before concerned Superintendent of Police on 14.11.2024 at 11.00 AM,
in the office of Superintendent of Police.

Superintendent of Police is directed to consider the grievances of the petitioner, strictly in accordance with law, within an upper limit of fortnight, and pass the requisite orders.
It is made clear that the Superintendent of Police is directed to consider the said matter, being unaffected from any observation made herein.
Accordingly, the present petition is disposed of.
Pending applications, if any, shall stand disposed of.

(SAMEER JAIN),J DEEPAK/s-147 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
